_comment: The 'genuine issue vs non-problem' rules for the weekly Diagnosis. A raw deficit/excess only becomes advice after passing this gauntlet, so the model is never handed a false alarm. Read by ingest/insights.py; horizon (daily/rolling) is NOT here because it already lives on the target. goal_weight ranks which issue leads the week (recomp goal: protein first). excess_posture stops over-target false alarms (cholesterol is track-only). coverage_floor is the missing-data guard: below it the nutrient reads as 'unknown', never 'deficit'. NOTE: the old deficit_from_food='weak' escape hatch is gone — it existed only for vitamin D and biotin, and those (with vitamin K and chloride) are no longer measured at all, because food is not their main vector. Every nutrient left in this file is one where the plate genuinely is the source, so a deficit here is always a real signal.

cholesterol_mg.note: Colesterol alimentar é um preditor fraco do LDL no sangue para a maioria das pessoas — é registado, não alarmado. Um painel lipídico vale mais do que o valor à mesa.
